title: Affinity JS Runtime, Environment & Hello World
tagline: Master programmatic graphic automation using the Affinity 3.0 JavaScript DOM and MCP server.
description: Understand the internal JavaScript automation engine of Serif Affinity 3.0: the embedded Google V8 engine, sandbox filesystem boundaries, module resolution (/application.js, /document.js), MCP SSE connection on port 6767, and authoring your first automation scripts for real-time document inspection and session telemetry.

starterAsset.statusNote: Verified runnable automation script tested against live Affinity 3.3.3 instance.
